paper:2026-5ced50bd4b.abstract: Fusion3DGS presents an end-to-end, label-efficient 3D instance segmentation framework that couples 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) with coordinated 2D–3D neural processing, learning entirely from multi-view RGB imagery and 2D SAM masks without requiring dense 3D point cloud annotations. The method introduces Voronoi densification and bilateral filtering for stable Gaussian geometry, an occlusion-aware visibility-masked cross-attention stack, and a gated weight-sharing lock between early 2D and 3D convolution kernels, achieving 56.8 mAP on ScanNetV2 and strong zero-3D-label generalization on the OIRGB dataset with low VRAM footprint.
